title: Stonewall uprising
summary: In the early hours of 28 June 1969 a police raid on the Stonewall Inn, a gay bar in New York's Greenwich Village, provoked a spontaneous act of resistance. Demonstrations continued over the next several nights at Christopher Park across the street and in the surrounding neighborhood. The National Park Service calls it a milestone for gay and lesbian civil rights that gave momentum to a movement, and the Library of Congress links it to the annual Pride traditions.
